findings.issue: API routes are defined without a leading slash (e.g., "api/v1/chat/completions"), so they will not match incoming requests like "/api/v1/chat/completions" and will return 404. This also means the endpoints are effectively unreachable and any auth middleware attached to them will never run.
findings.fix:
Add a leading slash to the path strings for all API routes.
```ts

  index("routes/landing.tsx"),
  route("/auth", "routes/auth.tsx"),
  route("/logout", "routes/logout.tsx"),
-  route("api/v1/chat/completions", "routes/api.v1.chat.completions.ts"),
-  route("api/v1/models", "routes/api.v1.models.ts"),

findings.issue: The base URL is escaped twice: first with `.replace(/"/g, "\\\"")` and then again with `JSON.stringify`. This produces a string like `\"https://example.com\"` which results in an invalid value for `window.__OMNIBRIDGE_BASE_URL__` on the client side.
